title: Ludots animation profiles
description: Mod-side Presentation/animation_profiles.json. Binds an animator controller's packed states to clip ids; duplicate packedStateIndex bindings within one profile are rejected at load time, and the removed field builtinClips fails loud. packedStateIndex defaults to 0. Field sets mirror AnimationProfileConfigLoader. Authoring guide: gitbook/reference/mod-editor-prd/config/pres-03-animation.md.
